## Boundary

Paths begin `tests/unit/`. `D[owner]`=leading string; `C[scope>next]`=maximal full-line region; `<previous>` is a disambiguating preceding-code anchor. Prefix with `tests/unit/<file>#D:` or `#C:<scope>:before:` and, when shown, `:after:`. Each resolves once.

Oracle retains three blobs; parses with `type_comments=True`; strips only allowlisted leading docstrings from current/final copies; normalizes only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; requires equal residual ASTs. Targets stay nonempty and shorter; tokens protect inline/unlisted comments. Current/final directive text+attachment (6) and shebangs (zero) stay exact.

## Protection / contracts / consumers
Protect every unlisted/inline prose block, runtime string, fixture, assertion, regex, prompt, and subprocess argument. In particular retain concise identity helpers/tests, `_write_create_event`, Jira schema helper contracts, and legacy-mirror fallback prose outside the one selected region. Keep all 6 directive-bearing physical lines exact; no owned blob has a shebang.

Preserve identity key/signing semantics; code/plan impact and versioning; init/failure seams; Jira DC authoring/onboarding/snapshot schema; JSON narrowing; kind compatibility; publication jitter; legacy material and signature-mirror behavior.

Pytest collects every module. ## Independent review receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 32 leaf-linked TSV PASS rows: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.

Before cites the frozen SHA; final cites its full SHA. Require `0 < after_words < before_words` and three PASS fields. Missing, duplicate, extra, author-reviewed, or non-PASS rows block closure.
